quick_facts.one_line: Sprint 7 — Complete Admin Panel and finalize MVP
quick_facts.sprint_goal: Implement and test complete admin panel (user management, disable/enable, platform stats); finalize all admin use cases (UC-08, UC-09, UC-10)

content.rationale: Sprint 5/6 completed the reporting module. Sprint 7 focuses on the final admin features necessary for MVP completion. Owner-facing features (UC-01 through UC-07) are implemented; admin-facing features (UC-08, UC-09, UC-10) require frontend + E2E validation.

planned_features.title: Admin User List Page with Pagination
planned_features.description: Frontend page showing all registered users with email, role, status, registered date, product count. Implements pagination (?page=1&limit=50). Connects to GET /admin/users endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Page renders paginated user table with 50 items per page
Shows columns: Email, Role (OWNER|ADMIN), Status (ACTIVE|DISABLED), Registered Date, Product Count
Pagination controls work (prev/next, jump to page)
Admin user badge distinguishes admin accounts
Links to Enable/Disable actions per user

planned_features.title: Disable/Enable User Account Actions
planned_features.description: Frontend modal + backend logic to disable/enable user accounts. Increments token_version on disable to invalidate all active sessions. Implements UC-09.
acceptance_criteria: Confirmation shows: 'Disable user {email}? This will log them out from all sessions.'
Disable sets status=DISABLED and increments token_version
Enable button visible on disabled users, re-enables account
Page refreshes to show updated status
E2E: Disabled user cannot log in after disable action

planned_features.title: Platform Stats Dashboard Widget
planned_features.description: Admin dashboard widget showing aggregate stats: total registered users, disabled users count, total products across all workspaces, total transactions (all time). Implements UC-10.
acceptance_criteria: Stats display on admin dashboard as 4-card widget
Cards show: Total Users, Disabled Users, Total Products, Total Transactions
Stats update when user list is refreshed
Numbers are correctly aggregated across all workspaces
E2E: Stats update after test user creates products

notes: GET /admin/users endpoint: needs verification (may already exist)
PATCH /admin/users/:id/status endpoint: needs verification (may already exist)
GET /admin/stats endpoint: needs verification (may already exist)
Token version invalidation on disable: verify implementation in guards
All endpoints require AdminGuard: verify @UseGuards(RolesGuard, AdminGuard)
Admin panel pages may be stubs
Form components (input, button, modal) available via shadcn/ui
React Query hooks for API calls: establish for admin endpoints

testing_scope: E2E: Admin login → view user list → paginate
E2E: Admin disable user → verify user cannot log in
E2E: Admin enable user → verify user can log in again
E2E: Platform stats reflect accurate counts
Unit: Token version validation logic on API calls
content.dependencies: None — all dependencies already resolved in previous sprints
risks: Admin endpoints may have incomplete implementation — review backend first
Token version checking may have edge cases in multi-request scenarios
Pagination offset calculation may differ from expected (0-indexed vs 1-indexed)
content.notes: Sprint 7 represents the final push to complete the MVP. After this sprint, all 10 use cases should be implemented, tested, and documented. Post-MVP work (Orders, Invoices, Stores integration) deferred to Sprint 8+.
